name: verigate-authority
description: Checks agent payment authority and can issue a capability-bound, one-time signed Execution Authorization for an external wallet or executor. Anna does not hold wallet keys or broadcast transactions; execution must pass through a Verigate enforcement adapter.
author: rudimentall1

tools.name: verigate_ai_review
tools.description: Ask the Anna host LLM to interpret a payment request or explain a Verigate decision. The Executa calls Anna through protocol-v2 sampling/createMessage; no provider API key is stored here. The response is advisory and never authorizes or executes an action.

parameters.name: system_prompt
parameters.description: Task-specific instruction for the advisory model call.

parameters.name: prompt
parameters.description: Untrusted request or decision context to review.

parameters.name: max_tokens
parameters.description: Maximum response tokens (1-2048).

tools.name: verigate_check
tools.description: Simulate a payment-shaped action against Verigate policy and return the signed ALLOW/WARN/BLOCK decision. This checks authority only; it does not submit, broadcast, or execute a payment, and it does not record anything.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: User-facing agent label only. It does not control identity, spend accounting or dynamic authority; those are bound to this installation issuer key.

parameters.name: payee
parameters.description: Recipient of the payment or action.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Asset being moved, e.g. USDC.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Network the action runs on, e.g. base.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Amount of the asset.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Optional resource the action pays for.

parameters.name: ai_flags_json
parameters.description: Optional JSON array of AI risk flags [{code, message}]. Advisory only: flags can raise ALLOW to WARN but never lower a decision.

tools.name: verigate_policy_summary
tools.description: Return active policy limits and this installation accounting principal. The optional agent_id is a display label only and never selects or resets accounting state. Read-only.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Optional display label; it does not select the accounting principal.

parameters.name: payee
parameters.description: Optional recipient for first-payment context.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Optional asset for rolling spend context.

tools.name: verigate_authorize_payment
tools.description: After the user explicitly confirms the exact payment in the Anna UI, evaluate it with persistent Verigate policy and issue a capability-bound, one-time signed Execution Authorization for ALLOW. A WARN may be converted to ALLOW only after a separate, exact, one-time App UI warning review; BLOCK can never be overridden. The fresh policy result and dynamic authority are rechecked before issuance. This does not send funds. A wallet/executor must enforce the authorization through Verigate ExecutionRouter before any side effect.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: User-facing agent label only. Identity and limits are bound to this installation issuer key, not to this caller-supplied string.

parameters.name: payee
parameters.description: Exact payment recipient.

parameters.name: asset
parameters.description: Payment asset, e.g. USDC.

parameters.name: network
parameters.description: Exact network, e.g. base.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Exact payment amount.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Payment purpose or invoice reference.

parameters.name: ai_flags_json
parameters.description: Advisory AI risk flags. They may only escalate ALLOW to WARN.

parameters.name: confirmation_nonce
parameters.description: One-time nonce created by the Anna App UI after explicit user confirmation. Direct chat invocation has no app-scoped approval record and fails closed.

parameters.name: approval_kind
parameters.description: Use payment_authorization for ALLOW or payment_warning_review for a separate explicit review of the exact WARN rules.

tools.name: verigate_verify_execution_authorization
tools.description: Read-only Ed25519 verification of a capability-bound one-time Execution Authorization. Returns the exact authorized action and expiry. Never consumes it.

parameters.name: authorization_json
parameters.description: Complete Execution Authorization JSON object.

tools.name: verigate_consume_execution_authorization
tools.description: Verify and consume a one-time EVM USDC Execution Authorization through Verigate ExecutionRouter. Requires a fresh one-time App UI confirmation for the exact wallet submission. Returns the exact signed Base/Ethereum transaction envelope for a connected wallet to review and submit. This tool never signs or broadcasts; a consumed permission cannot be reused, including after wallet rejection.

parameters.name: authorization_json
parameters.description: Complete signed Execution Authorization JSON object.

parameters.name: confirmation_nonce
parameters.description: One-time nonce created by the Anna UI after the user confirms wallet submission.

tools.name: verigate_record_wallet_submission_receipt
tools.description: After the connected EIP-1193 wallet returns a transaction hash, persist a signed SUBMITTED ExecutionReceipt for the already-consumed authorization. Requires a separate one-time Anna App-scope approval bound to the exact wallet hash and transaction. This is executor self-report only, not on-chain confirmation.

parameters.name: authorization_id
parameters.description: ID of the previously issued and consumed Execution Authorization.

parameters.name: transaction_hash
parameters.description: Exact 32-byte transaction hash returned by the connected wallet.

parameters.name: sender
parameters.description: Connected wallet address used for this submission.

parameters.name: confirmation_nonce
parameters.description: One-time App UI approval created after the wallet returned the transaction hash.

tools.name: verigate_record_wallet_outcome_receipt
tools.description: Persist an Ed25519-signed Anna self-report for an already-consumed wallet authorization. REJECTED is accepted only for EIP-1193 error 4001; ABORTED is accepted only when the wallet request was not started or a lost Router response is proven consumed in the nonce ledger; UNKNOWN records an ambiguous eth_sendTransaction result. This is not wallet-signed evidence or independent chain confirmation. Requires a fresh exact App-scope approval.

parameters.name: authorization_id
parameters.description: Previously issued and Router-consumed authorization ID.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: One of REJECTED, ABORTED or UNKNOWN.

parameters.name: phase
parameters.description: wallet_request, pre_wallet_request or router_response_unknown.

parameters.name: error_code
parameters.description: EIP-1193 provider error code, or null when unavailable.

parameters.name: error_message
parameters.description: Bounded wallet/runtime error description observed by Anna.

parameters.name: sender
parameters.description: Connected EVM sender address, or empty when account access was unavailable.

parameters.name: confirmation_nonce
parameters.description: Fresh one-time App-scope approval for this exact wallet outcome.

tools.name: verigate_verify_decision_receipt
tools.description: Cryptographically verify a Verigate Decision Receipt using this installation's trusted Ed25519 issuer public key. Returns the verification result, SHA-256 key fingerprint and PEM public key for independent verification.

parameters.name: receipt_json
parameters.description: Complete Decision Receipt JSON object.
